tools.name: clipboard_copy
tools.description: Copy text to the system clipboard.

text.description: The text to write to the clipboard. Sent verbatim — no trailing newline is appended.

tools.name: clipboard_copy_file
tools.description: Copy the contents of a file to the system clipboard. Use this when the content is already on disk (e.g. a temp file you just wrote) instead of inlining it as text.

path.description: Absolute filesystem path to the file whose contents should be copied. Must start with '/'.
